The paragraph presents a dispute between a landlord and a tenant regarding lease termination. The primary legal issues involve the validity of the eviction and the burden of proof. Specifically, the case-specific questions raised are: 1) Whether the landlord provided sufficient evidence to substantiate the allegation that illegal activities occurred on the premises, and 2) Whether the eviction was justified under applicable tenant protection laws, given the tenant's denial of the alleged activities.
